findings.detail: The Recommendations section gives the action and amount but not why Margaret should take it, as the specification requires. It also does not connect the recommendation to the relevant platform charge, although that charge appears later under Fees & Charges.
report_quote: We recommend moving £20,000 from the cash account into the Stocks & Shares ISA.

findings.detail: The meeting note says Margaret was happy that the portfolio had performed in line with her agreed moderate approach to risk. The report preserves her positive view but loses that qualification.

findings.detail: The report leaves the platform and advice charge rates for adviser confirmation, does not introduce a capital gains tax figure where no disposal is proposed, and retains the FCA line without exposing the internal instructions.
The report switches between referring to Margaret in the third person and addressing her as ‘you’. ‘In-scope accounts’ is internal-sounding wording that could be replaced with the account name.

An ongoing advice charge applies to the in-scope accounts on Holloway.
